signature_contract.out_mode: forbidden; Xray has no fourth OUT parameter mode
signature_contract.borrowed_result: normalized signature-owned origin parameter ordinal set

canonical_entities.value: typed SSA value with explicit ownership disposition
canonical_entities.place: verifier-confined SSA resource with pointee TypeId, origin and call-bound lifetime; not a language TypeId
canonical_entities.loan: function signature plus exact call/invoke interval; not a runtime object
canonical_entities.ownership_domain: logical transfer and drop obligation; never reconstructed from refcount or backend liveness
canonical_entities.cleanup: explicit CFG edges and owner.drop obligations; no ambient cleanup stack in XrProgram
canonical_entities.error_channel: explicit sealed invoke normal/error continuations and typed error block arguments; no implicit pending-error slot
canonical_entities.panic_channel: separate typed panic continuation/publication; never encoded as a business error

operation_atoms.law: call one sealed function and transfer exactly once to either normal or typed-error continuation
terminate with one deterministic uncatchable execution trap
consume one typed enum error value and terminate through the caller error continuation
operation_atoms.source: throw, rethrow or uncaught invoke error edge after cleanup

operation_atoms.law: consume one typed PanicInfo value and terminate through the panic continuation
produce one independent owner/domain according to the type copy capability
consume one owner and produce the same logical value under a new SSA owner exactly once
consume one owner and run its logical drop obligation exactly once
create a non-escaping call-bound place for one addressable local binding
operation_atoms.source: typed ref actual or ref parameter

operation_atoms.law: read a value through one verified live place without transferring the place
write one exact pointee-typed value through one verified exclusive live place

explicit_non_operations.borrow_begin_end: loan lifetime is structural signature and call-edge data
explicit_non_operations.cleanup_enter_leave: cleanup is explicit CFG plus owner.drop
explicit_non_operations.generic_place_field_or_index: value fields use aggregate.update; alias-visible and container projections require typed domain operations
explicit_non_operations.retain_release: physical RC is executor-private realization, not canonical semantics
explicit_non_operations.out_parameter: REF is the sole mutable place mode

xi_projection.xi.release: no canonical projection unless source/cleanup owner.drop identity is explicit
